backup.archive_unreadable: The archive {{name}} cannot be read ({{error}}). Nothing was touched.
backup.no_world_folder_in_archive: {{name}} contains none of the expected world folders ({{expected}}). The archive contains: {{contents}}. If the path layout no longer matches (older archives use a different one), the partial restore can be used. Nothing was touched.
backup.parts_not_in_archive: “{{parts}}” is not in {{name}}. The archive contains: {{contents}}.
lifecycle.mandatory_backup_failed: Mandatory backup failed — nothing was changed: {{error}}
lifecycle.restart_after_failure_failed: {{cause}} | WARNING: the server was running before and is now OFF — the restart failed ({{error}}). Manual intervention is needed.
lifecycle.stop_not_confirmed: The server is still running — nothing was changed. Writing over a running world would damage it.
operation.result_truncated: The result was {{length}} characters long and does not fit into the operation row.
provision.compose_managed: '{{key}}' is managed by Docker Compose: Compose creates its container, not the dashboard.
provision.config_failed: The configuration could not be created ({{reason}}). No container was created — otherwise the server would start without a control channel.
provision.container_exists: Container '{{container}}' already exists ({{state}}). Nothing was done; to replace it, use the version change or recreate it from the edit page.
provision.container_running: Container '{{container}}' is running. Stop the server before its container is replaced.
provision.data_dir_failed: The directory {{path}} could not be created ({{reason}}). It must be writable for the dashboard's user (APP_UID); nothing else was done.
provision.eula_required: The Minecraft EULA has not been accepted for '{{key}}'. The container would be created with EULA=TRUE, so the acceptance has to be recorded first.
provision.pull_failed: The image {{image}} could not be downloaded: {{reason}}
restore.boot_blocked: {{reason}} The backup “{{name}}” has been restored, the server stays stopped. The previous state is available as “{{safety}}”.
restore.boot_failed: The server did not come up after restoring “{{name}}”. Way back: {{steps}}. The backup of the previous state is called “{{safety}}”.
restore.extract_failed: Restore failed ({{error}}). The server stays stopped, the data may be incomplete — the backup “{{safety}}” holds the previous state.
restore.old_copy_left: The replaced version could not be deleted and still takes up space: {{paths}}. Remove it by hand.
server.bind_address_invalid: '{{value}}' is not an IP address. Use 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces), 127.0.0.1 (this host only) or one address of the host.
server.port_check_failed: Docker could not be asked which ports are in use ({{reason}}).
server.port_duplicate: Ports '{{name}}' and '{{other}}' are both {{port}}: one host port can be published only once.
server.port_format: Port '{{name}}' is '{{spec}}': write it as <port>/<tcp|udp> with a port from 1 to 65535, e.g. 25565/tcp.
server.port_in_use_container: Port {{port}} is already published by the running container '{{holder}}' ({{theirs}}). Choose another port, or stop that container first.
server.port_in_use_host: A port of '{{key}}' is already in use on the host ({{reason}}). Another program, not a container, holds it: choose another port or stop that program.
server.port_in_use_server: Port {{port}} is already used by server '{{holder}}' ({{theirs}}). Choose another port, or change or remove that server first.
server.remove_compose_data: '{{key}}' is managed by Docker Compose: its data belongs to the Compose block and is not deleted from here.
server.remove_container_failed: The container could not be removed ({{reason}}) — nothing else was changed.
server.remove_data_failed: {{count}} entries under {{path}} could not be deleted, not even by the cleanup container (first: {{first}}). The container is gone, the server is still listed: delete the rest on the host, then remove it again.
server.remove_data_is_root: {{path}} is a data root, not the folder of one server — nothing was deleted.
server.remove_data_link: {{path}} is a symbolic link or leads outside the data roots (to {{real}}) — nothing was deleted. Delete it on the host if that is really meant.
server.remove_data_shared: {{path}} is also used by server '{{other}}' — nothing was deleted. Keep the data, or remove that server first.
server.remove_enabled: '{{key}}' is switched on. Switch it off first (that stops its container), then remove it.
server.remove_unclassified: Per-server tables that are neither telemetry nor records: {{tables}}. Nothing was removed.
settings.public_host_invalid: '{{value}}' is not a host name or IP address. Enter the address alone, e.g. play.example.com or 203.0.113.10 — no http://, no port, no path.
version.change_failed_rollback_incomplet: Version change failed, ROLLBACK INCOMPLETE — check manually: {{error}}
version.change_failed_rolled_back: Version change failed, container and world rolled back: {{error}}
version.change_failed_world_not_rolled_b: Version change failed, container rolled back, BUT NOT THE WORLD — it is still in the state of the new version. The backup '{{backup}}' is the way back: {{error}}
version.completion_failed: The new version is running — only the completion (cleaning up old images, writing the history) failed: {{error}}
version.compose_managed: compose-managed: a version change is only possible once the dashboard manages the container
version.disk_space_low: Not enough space for '{{image}}': {{free_gb}} GB are free, about {{needed_gb}} GB are needed. Images that are no longer needed can be removed in the version tab.
version.game_type_unsupported: Game type '{{game_type}}' is not supported yet
version.image_pull_in_progress: Image '{{image}}' is being pulled ({{percent}} %) — please wait.
version.image_unavailable: Image '{{image}}' is neither present locally nor pullable: {{error}} — does the Docker socket proxy allow image operations (IMAGES=1)?
version.invalid_version: '{{version}}' is not a valid version for this game (e.g. 1.22.7).
version.no_history: No version history to roll back to
version.no_image_pull: This game pulls no images — the version comes from the image at boot.
version.prev_container_stuck: The container “{{name}}” from an earlier version change is still there and cannot be removed. As long as it exists, this change has no way back — so it is not even started. Check on the host: docker rm -f {{name}}
version.recreate_failed_rollback_incompl: Recreating the container failed, ROLLBACK INCOMPLETE — check manually: {{error}}
version.recreate_failed_rolled_back: Recreating the container failed; the previous container and the world are back. The saved settings are NOT applied: the server runs with the ones from before. {{error}}
version.recreate_failed_world_not_rolled: Recreating the container failed; the previous container is back, BUT NOT THE WORLD. The saved settings are NOT applied. The backup '{{backup}}' is the way back: {{error}}
world_lock.action_rejected: {{action}} rejected: {{operation}} is currently running for this server. Intervening in the middle of its boot check would make it look failed and roll back a healthy state.
world_lock.busy_please_wait: Already running for this server: {{operation}} — please wait.
world_lock.operation_not_executed: Already running for this server: {{operation}} — the operation was not executed. Please wait and trigger it again; its preparation (check, file list, run state) dates from before this point and would no longer be valid afterwards.
